company.name: Clickravel
company.shortDescription: Clickravel is a cost-effective POS device with ID authentication and linked through S'hail app to instantly book taxis with a simple tap.
company.description:
Clickravel is a travel technology platform that originated from Dubai’s innovation ecosystem to transform how travelers access and book transportation across the city. Initially incubated with support from Dubai’s Road & Transport Authority (RTA), Clickravel pioneered an integrated solution connecting taxis, public hotspots, and on-demand services through a unified app and IoT-enabled infrastructure.

By combining real-time data, seamless payments, and AI-driven routing, Clickravel aimed to create a frictionless travel experience for residents and tourists alike. The platform was selected among the Top 8 startups in Dubai for its potential impact on urban mobility, eventually serving as a foundation for large-scale smart transport solutions adopted city-wide.

Clickravel continues to explore opportunities in urban mobility, smart city integrations, and mobility-as-a-service (MaaS), with a focus on scalable, sustainable, and user-centric transport innovations.
